# Skribly Newsletter

> A free weekly newsletter with AI news worth reading and what is new in Skribly. Every item has its source; no tracking.

A short e-mail every week: what happened in AI that is worth your time, and what is new in Skribly.

## Pages

- [Issues](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/): Every issue of Skribly Newsletter, newest first: AI news with a source under every item. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/
- [About the newsletter](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/about/): Who writes Skribly Newsletter, how often it comes, how an issue is made and what it never does. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/o-newsletterze/
- [Privacy](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/privacy/): What Skribly Newsletter stores about a subscriber, why, for how long, and how to have it removed. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/prywatnosc/
- [RSS feed](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/rss.xml): RSS 2.0, every issue in full. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/rss.xml

## Issues

- [Issue 1: AI agents check Signal's code with proofs, and new models](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/issues/0001-agents-verify-signal/): Google DeepMind used AI agents to prove security properties of the code behind Signal. Also: Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon for everyone, open weights from Mistral and a coding agent from DeepSeek. Polish: https://newsletter.skribly.pl/pl/wydania/0001-agents-verify-signal/

## Optional

- [Licences](https://newsletter.skribly.pl/licenses/): The open source software and fonts that this site ships, each with its licence and its licence text.
